articles.title: Weekly injection reduces weight in adults
articles.summary: Weekly injection reduces weight in adults
articles.body_markdown: A trial of semaglutide, a GLP-1 receptor agonist, reported reduced body mass in adults with obesity. Gastrointestinal adverse events were common. Participants received the medicine by subcutaneous injection.

articles.title: Weight returns after semaglutide withdrawal
articles.body_markdown: Adults regained much of their lost weight after stopping semaglutide treatment. The extension study suggests continued therapy may be needed to maintain the benefit.

articles.title: Tirzepatide trial reports fewer breathing interruptions
articles.summary: Tirzepatide trial reports fewer breathing interruptions
articles.body_markdown: Participants with obesity and obstructive sleep apnea had fewer nighttime breathing interruptions after tirzepatide treatment. The report discusses apnea-hypopnea index and trial limitations.

articles.title: Compact language model runs without a network connection
articles.summary: Compact language model runs without a network connection
articles.body_markdown: An open-weight language model can execute entirely on a laptop. Private prompts remain on the device. Quantized weights reduce memory requirements, but the smallest configuration loses accuracy.

articles.title: Hosted model API introduces usage-based billing
articles.summary: Hosted model API introduces usage-based billing
articles.body_markdown: A remote AI service offers an application programming interface with per-token pricing. Prompts are sent to the provider infrastructure. The model requires an internet connection.

articles.title: Data center expands electrical capacity
articles.body_markdown: A cloud operator will add power capacity for GPU training clusters. The project involves substations, cooling equipment, and grid interconnection.

articles.title: Science center schedules hands-on weekend workshops
articles.summary: Science center schedules hands-on weekend workshops
articles.body_markdown: The indoor science center offers Saturday and Sunday experiments for children aged five to twelve. Advance reservations are required. Families can explore exhibits even when the weather is wet.

articles.title: County trail reopens after bridge repair
articles.summary: County trail reopens after bridge repair
articles.body_markdown: The riverside footpath is open for hiking. The two-mile walk has uneven ground and little shelter. Visitors should avoid the route during thunderstorms.

articles.title: Museum hosts evening architecture lecture
articles.body_markdown: The museum will host an adult lecture about urban design on Friday evening. Wine will be served. This event is not designed for young children.

articles.title: Battery preconditioning shortens winter charging stops
articles.summary: Battery preconditioning shortens winter charging stops
articles.body_markdown: An electric vehicle can warm its traction battery before arrival at a rapid charger. Cold cells accept less current. Owners can use navigation to trigger preconditioning, improving charging speed in freezing weather.

articles.title: Phone update adds battery charge limit
articles.summary: Phone update adds battery charge limit
articles.body_markdown: A smartphone software release adds an eighty-percent maximum charge option to reduce wear on lithium-ion cells during daily use.

articles.title: Air-source heat pumps retain output below freezing
articles.summary: Air-source heat pumps retain output below freezing
articles.body_markdown: A home heating trial measured performance of cold-climate heat pumps during subzero temperatures. Insulation and equipment sizing affect household electricity use.

articles.title: Orion 2 adds a longer context window
articles.summary: Orion 2 adds a longer context window
articles.body_markdown: The fictional Orion 2 language model expands the number of input tokens accepted in one request. This article reports the original launch, not the later Orion 2.1 patch.

articles.title: Orion 2.1 corrects structured-output failures
articles.body_markdown: The fictional Orion 2.1 release fixes malformed JSON when tools return empty arrays. The change is a patch to Orion 2, with no increase in context length.
